notes: Synthetic generic multiplexed subscribe RPC, deribit-shaped: one `kind: 'rpc'` command (`acme/subscribe`) whose sole recorded example subscribes to `ticker.ACME`, alongside a separate `kind: 'stream'` endpoint (`ws/book`) declaring `envelope.channel` routing for a different channel (`book.ACME`) reached through the exact same RPC method name. Regression fixture for the `match_rpc`/`match_subscribe` server-loop precedence bug: a live call for `book.ACME` is recognized by `match_rpc` (method matches) but mismatches its one example's `channels` params, and must fall through to `match_subscribe`'s declared-channel routing instead of the mock raising `UnexpectedSubscriptionParameters` immediately.

openapi.description: Subscribe to one or more channels.

reply.description: The subset of the requested channels actually subscribed to.
